name: Corgi FTSE 20+ Year U.S. Treasury Bond ETF
name_en: Corgi FTSE 20+ Year U.S. Treasury Bond ETF
desc: The fund invests at least 80% of the value of its net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, in U.S. dollar-denominated U.S. Treasury bond with a remaining maturity of at least twenty years that comprise the index. The index consists of U.S. domestic sovereign bonds eligible for the FTSE World Government Bond Index with a remaining maturity of at least twenty years. It is non-diversified.
